{c_important}Whisper Ambushes{/c} sometimes include {c_important}Bosses{/c}. 

These {c_important}Bosses{/c} will always burst out the contents of a {c_legendary}Greater Collection of Chaos{/c} when slain.

{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}22{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Destruction{/c}, Boss Ambushes have +{c_number}2{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} and drop {c_blue}Superior Lair Keys{/c}.
